rules.message: Do not treat balcony outer sash, interior partition sash, and direct-exterior room double sash as the same item or price basis.
No final sash order or quantity without measured clear opening W x H, divided sash segments, frame/glass specification and field evidence.
Keep legacy 자평 price unit intact; do not convert to square metres or reuse historical rates without explicit quote/unit validation.
For each physical sash assembly use distinct opening ID, side and location. Count inner and outer balcony units separately, but never double-charge the same assembly.
Bedroom and bathroom enclosed rooms must each have a validated entrance connection, but an open foyer-living or living-kitchen passage does not automatically require a door.
Balcony sliding access is included within its sash item; do not bill an additional ABS door for the same physical opening.
A proposed kitchen turning door needs verified existing opening or approved feasible structural design, hinge direction, adjacent kitchen/washer clearance and weather details.
Nominal door dimensions on SketchUp schematic are not site measurements. Distinguish frame opening, clear walking width, door leaf and height, plus elderly threshold needs.
Build spatial adjacency graph from real room connections; all required living/bedroom/bathroom areas must be reachable from outside entry. Master ensuite bath can be accessed through bedroom.
Compare KB and Npay/Naver floorplan by complex, exact area/subtype and rotate/mirror; field photos and measurement override unproven schematic.

For NEW designs with independently verified continuous rough opening >3000mm, prefer three visible glazed panels; alternative panel counts require documented review/approval and confirmed manufacturer/product suitability. Preserve legacy 2-section SKP geometries as sourced examples. No width inference from component bbox; do not conflate pane sections, moving leaves and tracks.

window_panel_policy.applies_to: individually verified continuous window assembly only
window_panel_policy.width_basis: site measured rough opening width for final design; existing native frame bbox only to find comparable source assets
window_panel_policy.at_or_below: choose verified source asset, e.g. 2-pane or 3-pane on project need; no mandatory 2 panes
window_panel_policy.historical_exceptions: Do not auto-convert old SKP components: 3050, 3107, 3162.5, 3200mm have verified 2 glazed sections in source models
window_panel_policy.installation_hold: No site cut or order from component bbox; require measured opening W×H, frame fit, actual moving/fixed leaves per track, glass load/safety, installation constraints
window_panel_policy.legacy_width_basis: Existing source native frame bbox used only for study; not rough opening in new design
window_panel_policy.production_status: NOT_DEPLOYED; review branch only; no SketchUp automatic hook

legacy_rules.message: For every continuous physical window opening greater than 2700mm, specify three panels. Verify actual opening width and panel layout; hold incompatible or unknown product configurations. Do not confuse double sash with panel count.
legacy_rules.reason: Guri 2739/2904mm and multiple >3000mm native components have 2 visible glass sections; user prefers review at 3000 rather than auto-rule at 2700
